title: Coinsurance Collected Ahead of the Explanation of Benefits — Insured Plan of Care Pre-Visit Payments
content:
**Insured Plan of Care.** When a patient pays ahead of a visit, the coinsurance share above the deductible still to be met is collected with that payment, ahead of the explanation of benefits, in place of waiting for that coinsurance to be posted after it.

**Rule.** Beyond the deductible part, the pre-visit amount also includes:

| Expected allowed amount compared with the deductible still to be met | Coinsurance percentage on the plan | Copay charges posted on the plan | Included beyond the deductible part |
|---|---|---|---|
| More | Above zero | — | That coinsurance percentage of the part of the expected allowed amount above the deductible still to be met, rounded half up to the cent |
| More | None (zero) | Yes | The copay on file |
| More | None (zero) | No | Nothing |
| Equal or less | — | — | Nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Expected allowed amount $132.00, deductible still to be met $50.00, coinsurance 20%: 20% of $82.00, that is $16.40.
- Expected allowed amount $132.00, deductible still to be met $0.00, coinsurance 15%: 15% of $132.00, that is $19.80.
- Expected allowed amount $132.00, deductible still to be met $50.00, no coinsurance percentage, copay charges already posted on the plan, copay on file $30.00: $30.00.
- Expected allowed amount $132.00, deductible still to be met $132.00: nothing, because the expected allowed amount is not more than the deductible still to be met.
